import pathlib
p=pathlib.Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-low-ws0/frozen/held-out-4/play/users/u040/system/state/workspace/programs/task-7cdc340b.py')

p.write_text('''def transform(g):
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in g]
    for c in range(w):
        if not any(g[r][c] == 5 for r in range(h)):
            continue
        sources = [(r, g[r][c]) for r in range(h) if g[r][c] not in (0, 5)]
        for r in range(h):
            if g[r][c] == 0 and sources:
                below = [item for item in sources if item[0] > r]
                out[r][c] = min(below, key=lambda item: item[0])[1] if below else 5
    return out
''')
